sentences.text: 3. As per the prosecution case, on false pretext of marriage, this petitioner made physical relations with the informant for more than five years.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that at the time when physical relationship was established between the parties, both parties were major and they continued to enjoy each other's company for years together.

It is next submitted Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41059 of 2024(2)

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this anticipatory bail is allowed and it is ordered that let the above named petitioner in the event of his arrest/surrender before the court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.
10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Special Judge (POCSO), Darbhanga in connection with Mahila P. S. Case No. 18 of 2024, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 15-07-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376,
323, 354(C), 354(D), 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, on false pretext of marriage, this petitioner made physical relations with the informant for more than five years.
It is next submitted Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41059 of 2024(2)
dt.15-07-2024 that the informant was well aware of the consequences of such relationship and merely because the relationship did not work out, this case has been instituted under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code only with a view to harass the petitioner.
Petitioner claims clean antecedent.
